objects.name: HPE security advisory (AV26-633)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-633 Date: June 25, 2026 On June 25, 2026, HPE published a security advisory to address a critical vulnerability in the following product: HPE Telco Service Orchestrator – versions prior to v5.6.1 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply the necessary updates. HPESBNW05070 rev.1 - HPE Telco Service Orchestrator Software, Multiple Vulnerabilities HPE Security Bulletin Library
